envelope.description: Implement bounded Linux zstd and tar decoding

body.title: Implement bounded Linux zstd and tar decoding
body.summary: Add the pinned bundled fzstd streaming path and validated tar reader for official Linux payloads, reusing existing safe path/inventory patterns and returning controlled layout metadata for later qualified alias materialization.
acceptanceChecks: Pin and bundle the decoder; validate zstd frame/window headers before allocation, enforce its 2^25-byte backreference limit and compressed/expanded/per-file/count/memory bounds, and fail closed on malformed/truncated/multiframe input.

Canonical tar members reject traversal, absolute/drive/UNC paths, ADS, collisions, device nodes and link escapes before any unsafe write; link metadata is never traversed or created as an on-disk archive link.
Bound parsing/output chunks and yield/check AbortSignal so cancellation and progress remain responsive; errors leave only contained private staging with no publication.
Linux extraction never invokes the privileged upstream installer, root/system decompressor, GPU driver setup or model work. Actual large official-archive qualification remains the later route task.
